dingtalk-message v0.1.0

- Initial release providing comprehensive DingTalk message sending capabilities.
- Supports group custom Webhook robots (text/Markdown/ActionCard/Link/FeedCard, with signing & @mentions), corporate robot single/group chat (retract/read/notification), work notification, and sessionWebhook reply.
- Detailed decision logic, configuration reading, and workflow outlined in the strategy guide.
- Includes handling for token caching, identification types (userId/unionId), and robust error handling scenarios. 
- Step-by-step guidance for message type selection, required permissions, and practical workflow scripting recommendations.
